gui.simplecrucibles.crucible.two_below: Heat source two blocks below: 10% slower
tip.simplecrucibles.crucible: Heated by the block below; cooks every slot at once
tip.simplecrucibles.barrel: Next to a crucible, axe strikes attach it
simplecrucibles.guide.page.1.title: Simple Crucibles
simplecrucibles.guide.page.1: Iron, Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite crucibles that cook every slot at once without fuel, barrels that dock onto them, the reinforced cauldron and village field kitchens.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.2.title: Crucibles
simplecrucibles.guide.page.2: A cooking station without fuel that cooks every slot at once, heated by the block below.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.3.title: Village field kitchens
simplecrucibles.guide.page.3: Villages of all five types can have a small field kitchen: an iron crucible on an unlit campfire with cooked food, a barrel of raw meat and a seat.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.4.title: Reinforced cauldron
simplecrucibles.guide.page.4: A cauldron for water, lava, powder snow and - with SimpleBuilding - soul lava; lava in it heats a crucible like a lava source.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.5.title: First pickup tips
simplecrucibles.guide.page.5: The first time you pick up a machine or tool whose use is not obvious, one short tip shows in the action bar - once per player and world.
quests.simplecrucibles.start.title: Welcome to Simple Crucibles
quests.simplecrucibles.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simplecrucibles.start.welcome.des: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Crucibles Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a cauldron.
